tracedAction: Held that reconstruction should be externally funded and decoupled from broader reform conditionality; Lebanon remained locked out of concessional lending in the absence of comprehensive reform.
tracedActionAr: اعتبر أن إعادة الإعمار ينبغي أن تموَّل خارجياً وأن تُفصل عن مشروطية الإصلاح الأوسع؛ وبقي لبنان محروماً من الإقراض الميسّر في غياب إصلاح شامل.
summary: Held that reconstruction should be externally funded and decoupled from broader reform conditionality; Lebanon remained locked out of concessional lending in the absence of comprehensive reform.
